## Criteria

| Criterion | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| AC-1: grams to ounces, one decimal place | not met | `test_grams_convert_to_ounces_to_one_decimal` (`tests/test_units.py:7`) fails: `convert(100, "g")` gives `(4, 'oz')`, because `src/units.py:10` rounds to a whole number. |
| AC-2: cups to millilitres, 240 ml per cup | met | `test_cups_convert_to_millilitres` (`tests/test_units.py:10`) passes; `src/units.py:11-12`. |
| AC-3: an unknown unit raises ValueError | met | `test_unknown_unit_is_rejected` (`tests/test_units.py:13`) passes; `src/units.py:13`. |

## Not changed

I did not touch the code: `AGENTS.md:10` asks that a failing criterion is reported, not fixed, while the claims are
written. AC-1 needs `src/units.py:10` to round to one decimal; then the tests and these claims should be run again.
